note: Exact shell commands captured from actual tool invocations. Independent read/check calls were launched concurrently; sequence records invocation order, not completion order. Actual checker stdout is preserved in the named Markdown check files.

commands.label: resource and input hashing; first-draft word count
commands.command:
$resourcePaths = @(
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\SKILL.md'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\references\argument.md'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\references\framing-results.md'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\references\voice-en.md'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\references\analysis-bridge.md'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\references\quantitative-discussion.md'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\references\qualitative-narrative.md'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\references\conclusion-implications.md'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\..\edu-shared\references\integrity.md'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\scripts\check_voice.py'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\scripts\check_prose.py'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v2\skills\edu-writing\references\methods\cases-develop-explanations.md'
)
$inputPaths = @(
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\inputs\D-M02\new-request.md'
'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\inputs\D-M02\source-pack.md'
)
$loadedResources = @($resourcePaths | ForEach-Object {
    $resolvedResource = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $_).Path
    [pscustomobject]@{path=$resolvedResource; sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $resolvedResource -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); usage=$(if ($resolvedResource -match 'check_(voice|prose)\.py$') {'read and executed'} else {'read'})}
})
$taskInputs = @($inputPaths | ForEach-Object {
    [pscustomobject]@{path=$_; sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_ -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()}
})
$draftBody = ((Get-Content -LiteralPath '<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\runs\D-M02-new-r1-v2\first-draft.md' -Raw -Encoding UTF8) -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch '^#\s'}) -join "`n"
[pscustomobject]@{resources=$loadedResources; inputs=$taskInputs; firstDraft=[pscustomobject]@{path='<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\runs\D-M02-new-r1-v2\first-draft.md'; body_words=([regex]::Matches($draftBody.Trim(), '\S+')).Count; sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath '<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\runs\D-M02-new-r1-v2\first-draft.md' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); counting_rule='Whitespace-delimited body tokens; separate attribution heading excluded; hyphenated words and apostrophes remain within a word.'}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

commands.label: final artifact validation
commands.command:
$outputDirectory = '<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\runs\D-M02-new-r1-v2'
$draftRecords = @('first-draft.md', 'revised-draft.md', 'final.md') | ForEach-Object {
    $artifactPath = Join-Path $outputDirectory $_
    $artifactText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $artifactPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8
    $bodyText = (($artifactText -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch '^#\s'}) -join "`n"
    [pscustomobject]@{
        file=$_
        path=$artifactPath
        sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $artifactPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
        body_words=([regex]::Matches($bodyText.Trim(), '\S+')).Count
        heading_count=([regex]::Matches($artifactText, '(?m)^#{1,6}\s')).Count
        replacement_character_present=$artifactText.Contains([char]0xFFFD)
    }
}
$requiredFiles = @('rationale.md', 'self-review.md', 'notes.md', 'loaded-resources.json', 'task-input-hashes.json', 'first-draft-check-voice.md', 'first-draft-check-prose.md', 'revised-draft-check-voice.md', 'revised-draft-check-prose.md')
$missingFiles = @($requiredFiles | Where-Object { -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $outputDirectory $_) -PathType Leaf) })
$resourcesManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $outputDirectory 'loaded-resources.json') -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$inputsManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $outputDirectory 'task-input-hashes.json') -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
[pscustomobject]@{
    counting_rule='Whitespace-delimited body tokens; attribution heading excluded; hyphenated words and apostrophes remain within a word.'
    drafts=@($draftRecords)
    first_draft_preserved=($draftRecords[0].sha256 -eq '81479a11b031b67b0c0ada8fab4431fecce8f3690c6bf88abf2fa7f5f636738c')
    final_matches_checked_revision=($draftRecords[1].sha256 -eq $draftRecords[2].sha256)
    final_length_valid=($draftRecords[2].body_words -ge 350 -and $draftRecords[2].body_words -le 450)
    final_has_only_attribution_heading=($draftRecords[2].heading_count -eq 1)
    missing_required_files=$missingFiles
    loaded_resource_records=@($resourcesManifest.resources).Count
    task_input_records=@($inputsManifest.inputs).Count
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
